describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal mammal with the overall body, fur, head and limbs of a brown bear, but with insect-like features integrated into its back and forehead. It stands in profile facing right, covered in thick shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle and chest and darker on the lower legs. A large, glossy, dark reddish-brown to black segmented exoskeleton covers the entire dorsal side from the shoulders to the rump, and a single large curved, notched horn rises from the forehead. The animal has a bear-like snout, small rounded ears, four clawed paws, and a very short tail, with a row of oval openings visible on the fur just below the edge of the shell.

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal shown in side profile facing right, covered in dense shaggy brown fur with a bear-like head, long muzzle, black nose and brown eyes. It stands on four stout furry limbs ending in clawed paws, with a short furry stub at the rear. Its entire back from behind the neck to the rump is covered by a dark reddish-brown glossy hard segmented armor with a larger smooth shield over the shoulders. Just below the lower edge of the armor on the furry flank is a row of dark oval openings with pale rims. A single long glossy black curved horn with tooth-like notches along its inner edge rises upward from the forehead.
